'''Redok Harvast''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

He wore [[Color/Legends|brown and silver]] [[Mandalorian Seeker armor]].

==Behind the scenes==
Redok Harvast appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a trainer for the bounty hunter class on Corellia.
